title: Camera preview windows (live + stereo difference) and sensing settings

steps.title: how
steps.note: how skill: 3 read-only explorers (capture, controller/UI, settings) + 1 explainer; found camera-off not sticky, pipeline keeps first settings, timings hard-coded, no stop-gesture flag

steps.title: architect
steps.note: Arena: 2 candidate designs + cross-judge; base = candidate 1 (prefs table, camera.json, idempotent sync, pipeline draws previews); grafts: perceived seconds, error latch, optional controller prefs hook

steps.title: checkpoint
steps.note: Blocking: shared types+prefs table; server and client disjoint but coupled by wire type; one writer per state; single implementer owns the diff

steps.title: implement
steps.note: Delegated to an implementer subagent against the synthesized design; 289 vitest pass

steps.title: verify
steps.note: 289 vitest; verify-aios PASS; Chromium + real MediaPipe + synthetic stereo clip: both tiles render, settings persist to camera.json, camera-off survives reload

steps.title: review
steps.note: Independent review: 6 findings (voice phrase collisions, bad camera.json fails open, write-before-memory, cooldown, start race, docs); all fixed by a fresh implementer with regression tests; 335 vitest pass

steps.title: pr
steps.note: PR 21 merged by owner before review fixes; fixes in PR 22
